surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 17 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah At-Taariq (The Morning Star) is the 86th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 17 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والسماء والطارق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the sky and the night comer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the sky and the night-comer––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is the night comer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the night-comer is

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: there is a watcher over every soul

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So let man observe from what he was created
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Man should reflect on what he was created from

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He was created from a fluid, ejected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He is created from spurting fluid

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then he emerges from between the backbone and breastbone

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God is certainly able to bring him back to life

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day when secrets will be put on trial
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On the Day when secrets are laid bare

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةࣲ وَلَا نَاصِرࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then man will have no power or any helper
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he will have no power and no one to help him
By the sky and its recurring rain

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the earth which cracks open
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the earth that cracks open

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is truly a decisive statement
it is not something to be taken lightly

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, they are planning a plan
But I am planning a plan
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], let the disbelievers be, let them be for a while
